cuts.raw_narration: The video opens cold on a giant, shadowy insect-like creature baring huge teeth. In a low, ominous voice she declares that she has a duty to fulfill: she has to give birth to the king.

The research team shows the two boys a severed insect claw and reveals their computer analysis came back as a 99 percent match for a chimera ant queen. The white-haired boy holds the claw up and realizes it is as big as a human finger, which means the ant it came from must be enormous.

The researcher explains the most disturbing fact about chimera ants: they reproduce through a process called phagogenesis. When the queen eats other creatures, she passes the characteristics of whatever she ate onto her offspring, mixing the genes of multiple species into the next generation.

Inside a dark cave, the chimera ant queen addresses her soldiers. She proclaims her solemn duty to give birth to the king and demands they bring her large quantities of highly nutritious food so the king will be born strong, ordering them to go out and find her the best food they can.

After two village children are attacked, the queen tastes what the soldiers brought back and is delighted. She calls it delicious and incredibly nutritious, declares it the best fodder, and resolves that she must consume more of this species, making it clear humans are now her preferred food.

A newly born chimera ant shocks the queen by speaking in full sentences, pledging to fully receive, understand, and execute her orders. Pleased, she names it a squadron leader and orders it to lead the soldiers in capturing more of the highly nutritious organisms. The narrator closes by stating that a chimera ant has been born with human genes, and that the worst fears of the boys' mentor have finally come to pass.
